description: Defines the QuicCrypter class interface for encryption and decryption in QUIC protocol, including methods for setting keys, nonces, and header protection.

classes.name: quic::QuicCrypter
classes.description: Interface for QUIC encryption/decryption operations, including key and nonce management.

methods.name: SetNoncePrefix
methods.description: Sets the fixed initial bytes of the nonce for Google QUIC.

methods.name: SetIV
methods.description: Sets the initialization vector for IETF QUIC.

methods.name: SetNoncePrefixOrIV
methods.description: Chooses between SetNoncePrefix or SetIV based on QUIC version.

methods.name: SetHeaderProtectionKey
methods.description: Sets the key for header protection.

methods.name: GetKeySize
methods.description: Returns the size of the encryption key.

methods.name: GetIVSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the IV.

methods.name: GetNoncePrefixSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the nonce prefix.
